messages:
Riley: Heads-up — NovaCloud QBR addendum. Overnight credit alert popped and onboarding is ~75% done. We need: 30-day burn projection, immediate throttle options, an enablement checklist for before the QBR, and two customer-friendly asks (credit cushion or opt-in throttles). Priya, can you run the forecast? Noah, quick infra/state notes? Zoe, can you draft the 30s customer ask copy? Kaito, standby for promo escalation.

Priya: Running now. I'll produce three scenarios: baseline, quick wins (-12%), and optimized (-28% with batching + cache). Will include tokens->credits->USD conversion and a CSV export. ETA 20m.

Onboard-Bot: Alert at 6314159265: account=novacloud, credit_balance=1350 (~11% left), avg_daily_usage=1020 credits/day, projected_runway~=1.32 weeks.

Noah: No infra incidents. Observed many short-lived embedding calls causing high per-call overhead. Quick mitigations: 1) Temporary embeddings RPM cap (48-72h), 2) Client-side batching snippet, 3) Enable prefix cache for repeated contexts.

Zoe: Draft ask text: "To avoid disruption, we recommend either A) a one-time 20% credit top-up to reach a healthy runway, or B) enabling short-term conservative throttles plus a 45m optimization workshop with our team. We suggest option B as cost-effective; we can pair it with a 2-week discretionary buffer if savings show." I'll put this on a 2-slide packet.

Riley: Action owners: Priya (forecast + CSV/png) 20m, Zoe (2 slides) EOD, Noah (throttle/playbook) 30m, Kaito (escalation) on-call. Priya, please include a 20% reduction scenario and exact dollar estimates.

Priya: Results posted: baseline runway ~9.8 days; -12% -> ~11 days; -28%+batching -> ~15.7 days. Conversion: 1k tokens ≈ 3 credits; 1 credit ≈ $0.0045. CSV/PNG attached to QBR packet.

Riley: Enablement checklist for customer before QBR: 1) Deploy prefix cache snippet we provide, 2) Switch to client batcher, 3) Apply temporary RPM throttle for embeddings, 4) Join 45m optimization workshop, 5) Review 7-day post-workshop savings. Noah please paste throttle pseudo-config in thread.

Noah: Throttle pseudo-config:
```
embeddings_throttle:
  target_rpm: 50
  duration: 72h
  rollback_if: errors_rate > 0.5% OR p99_latency > baseline * 1.5
  resume_if: 7d_avg_usage <= baseline * 0.8
  monitor: ["credits/day","errors/5m","p99_latency"]
```
I'll also add alerts for CS and AE on trigger.

Kaito: Standing by. If Priya shows <14 days, I'll escalate for an emergency 1-month uplift. If 14-30 days, discretionary 2-week buffer possible.

Riley: Thanks team — I'll assemble the QBR addendum once artifacts are in. Short and actionable to avoid renewal friction. :thumbsup:
